content: Do not look for the morning bird in the nest it abandoned yesterday.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Once fledglings take flight into the open sky, the woven twigs of the old nest are left behind to disintegrate in the rain. To keep revisiting old grievances, dead relationships, or former identities is to rummage through cold, abandoned straw. Fly in the new sky.
practicalInsight: Stop revisiting a dead argument or old version of yourself today. Spread your wings in the present.
reflectionPrompt: What abandoned 'nest' of old identity or past grief are you still flying back to inspect?
